The Problem
The Bottleneck Is Not Your Team

Walk through any service business and the patterns are identical. The front desk texts customers from a personal phone. The owner checks five apps to understand their own pipeline. Leads go cold because no one followed up within the hour. Reviews accumulate unanswered. Every month, the same manual work repeats.

The Cost
Response time: 78% of customers buy from whoever responds first.
Follow-up: 44% of businesses give up after one attempt.
Reputation: Unanswered reviews reduce call volume by 35%.

These are not people problems. They are infrastructure problems.

Our Process
How We Work
01

Discovery

1-2 Weeks

We sit inside your business. We watch how work actually happens — who does what, how long it takes, where things break. This is not a questionnaire. It is a diagnostic.

Output: A scored assessment across 12 operational dimensions, with prioritized automation opportunities and estimated impact.
02

Build

4-8 Weeks

We design and deploy custom systems directly inside your existing tools. No platform migrations. No learning curves. Everything runs where your team already works.

Output: Live automation running in your business — tested, documented, and production-ready.
03

Adoption

Ongoing

A system nobody uses is expensive decoration. We train your team role by role, embed the workflows into daily operations, and track adoption until it holds.

Output: A team that runs independently, with measurable time savings tracked from week one.

Capabilities
Systems, Not Services
Every engagement is scoped to your business. Below is a representative sample of what we deploy.
Automated Lead Response
New inquiry to qualified response within 60 seconds. Text, email, or call. 24/7, including weekends and holidays.
Replaces: Receptionist — $2,800-4,300/mo
AI Appointment Setting
Conversational AI that books meetings from inbound messages. Handles objections, follows up, confirms. No human in the loop.
Replaces: SDR/Setter — $3,500-5,000/mo
Review Management Engine
Automated review requests after every job. Smart gating prevents negative public reviews. AI-drafted responses to every review.
Replaces: Reputation agency — $1,500-3,500/mo
Follow-Up Sequencing
Multi-channel drip campaigns that fire automatically. Text, email, voicemail drop. Stops when they reply.
Replaces: Sales rep follow-up — $4,000-5,500/mo
Competitive Intelligence
Real-time monitoring of competitor reviews, pricing, and ad presence. Delivered as a weekly briefing with actionable insights.
Replaces: Market research — $2,000-4,000/mo
Custom CRM and Pipeline
White-labeled pipeline management built for your workflow. Every lead, every stage, every metric — visible in one place.
Replaces: Off-the-shelf CRM + admin — $1,200-3,000/mo

Case Study
Automotive E-Commerce Platform
Vaughan, Ontario
The Problem

New tire marketplace with no digital presence, no inventory system, and no way to convert online traffic to sales. Competing against established retailers with mature e-commerce operations and years of review history.

What We Built
  • Full e-commerce platform with real-time inventory sync
  • AI-powered tire finder — search by vehicle, size, or brand
  • Automated pricing engine with wholesale cost, margin targets, and competitor benchmarking
  • Mobile-responsive storefront with Google Reviews integration
  • Branded product cards with specifications, ratings, and fitment data
The Result
Time to Launch
Concept to production in under 6 weeks
Catalog
Full inventory live with automated pricing
Competitive Position
Professional e-commerce experience on par with established retailers
Operations
Zero manual inventory or pricing updates required
